parsed.name: Grove 16×2 RGB背光字符液晶屏
parsed.description: 这是一款 Grove 接口的 I2C 16×2 字符液晶显示模块，带 RGB 或单色背光，可用于在实验系统中显示传感器读数、设备状态、菜单和提示信息。
parsed.description_en: This is a Grove I2C 16x2 character LCD module with RGB or monochrome backlight, used in laboratory setups to display sensor readings, device status, menus, and user prompts.

actions.description: 按给定的 RGB 颜色值设置背光颜色。
actions.description_en: Set the backlight color using the provided RGB values.

actions.description: 打开或关闭液晶屏背光。
actions.description_en: Turn the LCD backlight on or off.

actions.description: 向液晶屏发送一个字节，作为命令或显示数据。
actions.description_en: Send one byte to the LCD as either a command or display data.

actions.description: 初始化液晶屏以开始显示。
将字符串写入指定显示行。
actions.description_en: Write a string to a specified display line.

actions.description: 切换液晶屏的使能信号。
将提供的多行文本写入液晶屏显示。
actions.description_en: Write the provided multiple text lines to the LCD display.

actions.description: 设置光标所在的行列位置。
actions.description_en: Set the cursor position by row and column.

actions.description: 设置背光的红、绿、蓝亮度值。
actions.description_en: Set the red, green, and blue backlight levels.
Set the text shown on the LCD.

actions.description: 向液晶控制器发送底层命令。
actions.description_en: Send a low-level command to the LCD controller.

actions.description: 向液晶控制器发送底层显示数据。
actions.description_en: Send low-level display data to the LCD controller.
